options.name: accounting
options.description: Advanced accounting settings

options.name: cgroups
options.description: Submode containing LSF related cgroups settings

options.name: cloneFrom
options.description: The id or name of the entity that the new entity will be cloned from.  (take effect only at entity creation)

options.name: dcgmPort
options.description: Enable DCGM features and specifies the port number that LSF uses to communicate with the DCGM daemon (0 for disabled)

options.name: doBackups
options.description: Backup configuration file before update

options.name: dynamicCloudNodes
options.description: Cloud nodes are added dynamically to LSF

options.name: dynamicHostWaitTime
options.description: Defines the length of time in seconds that a dynamic host awaits communicating with the master host LIM to either add the host to the cluster or to shut down any running daemons if the host is not added successfully. Note that the time will be truncated to the minute (LSF_DYNAMIC_HOST_WAIT_TIME in lsf.conf)

options.name: enableEgo
options.description: Enable EGO functionality (LSF_ENABLE_EGO in lsf.conf)

options.name: enablePrejob
options.description: Enable Bright Cluster Manager powered prejob healthchecking in the workload manager

options.name: gpuAutoconfig
options.description: Enable GPU autodetection (LSF_GPU_AUTOCONFIG in lsf.conf)

options.name: gpuNewSyntax
options.description: Enable new GPU request syntax (LSB_GPU_NEW_SYNTAX in lsf.conf)

options.name: hostAddressRange
options.description: Identifies the range of IP addresses that are allowed to be LSF hosts that can be dynamically added to or removed from the cluster (LSF_HOST_ADDR_RANGE in lsf.conf)

options.name: localVar
options.description: Local var directory location

options.name: logDir
options.description: Logging directory location (LSF_LOGDIR in lsf.conf)

options.name: manageMIG
options.description: enable dynamic MIG scheduling (LSF_MANAGE_MIG in lsf.conf)

options.name: moduleFileTemplate
options.description: Template content for system module file

options.name: name
options.description: Name

options.name: network
options.description: Network that will be used to form FQDN node names

options.name: noQueueHostsString
options.description: String that is used to replace empty nodes list for a queue

options.name: placeholders
options.description: Job queue node placeholders mode

options.name: prefix
options.description: LSF installation directory

options.name: primaryServer
options.description: The WLM primary server (where the active WLM daemon will be running).

options.name: state
options.description: The state the resource should have

options.name: topologySwitches
options.description: List of switches that should be used to write the topology file

options.name: tracingJobs
options.description: A list of job ids to trace in CMDaemon

options.name: unitForLimits
options.description: Enables scaling of large units in the resource usage limits (LSF_UNIT_FOR_LIMITS in lsf.conf)

options.name: var
options.description: Var directory location

options.name: version
options.description: Major LSF version
